input.quote: the collection, maintenance, management and storage of visitor information (data), to the extent collected, directed by, maintained or stored by Kubient, as well as the performance of the Auction Platform, is and shall be in a secure manner using best practices of security technology
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no insurance obligation anywhere: searches for insurance, coverage, certificates and policy return nothing, and the General Provisions (p0063-p0073) run from governing law to counterparts with no insurance covenant, nor is any exhibit with insurance terms incorporated. Kubient hosts the Auction Platform and collects, stores and manages our visitor data (p0035), so an uninsured data-processing vendor sits in walk-away territory. We therefore insert a short covenant at the preferred level in General Provisions: CGL USD 1,000,000 per occurrence / USD 2,000,000 aggregate, E&O USD 2,000,000, cyber and privacy USD 5,000,000 where Kubient processes any data belonging to, supplied by or processed for Customer, statutory workers' compensation, and certificates on request. Fallback (E&O USD 1M / cyber USD 2M) is available if Kubient pushes back.

proposal.summary: Insert a vendor insurance covenant (CGL, E&O, cyber, workers' compensation, certificates) into General Provisions.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement has no insurance covenant even though Kubient hosts the Auction Platform and processes our visitor data, so we added our standard coverages (CGL USD 1M/2M, E&O USD 2M, cyber USD 5M, statutory workers' compensation) with certificates on request. We can fall back to E&O USD 1M and cyber USD 2M if needed.

ops.text: Kubient shall maintain throughout the Term: commercial general liability insurance of not less than USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 in the aggregate; professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000; where Kubient processes any data belonging to, supplied by or processed for Customer, cyber and privacy liability insurance of not less than USD 5,000,000; and workers' compensation insurance as required by applicable Law. Kubient shall provide certificates of insurance to Customer on request.

mappings.element: Commercial general liability coverage is at least USD 1,000,000 per occurrence.
Commercial general liability coverage is at least USD 2,000,000 in the aggregate.

If Vendor processes Customer Data, cyber and privacy coverage is at least USD 5,000,000.
